canonical_pdf_vector_schema: compact JSON with no trailing newline: [{lcsc_id,mpn,source_sha256},...] in frozen order
policy: Gate-protected, complementary-pair, multi-die, integrated-network, depletion/JFET, other unsupported topology, and invalid source artifacts receive zero model calls and remain in the denominator.
method: All 40 exact filenames were signature/hash checked. Thirty-nine valid PDFs were layout-extracted and their canonical first pages rendered and visually inspected. Ambiguous protected/multi-die pages were rendered at higher resolution, including STN1NK80Z page 2. The invalid NTR4101PT1G frozen object was freshly reacquired from the exact URL and reproduced the same malformed page tree; official onsemi page 1 was visually checked only to confirm identity and topology, not admitted as an extraction source.
